U.S. Department of Energy (2003). Improving Fan System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry. Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy, Industrial Technologies Program, and Air Movement and Control Association International, Inc. (AMCA International); prepared by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and Resource Dynamics Corporation. DOE/GO-102003-1294, April 2003.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 4). A guidance sourcebook: fan-type efficiencies (forward-curved 55-65%, radial-tip up to 75%, backward-inclined airfoil >85%, vaneaxial up to 85%), drive efficiencies (gears 70-98%, belts 90-95% derived from 5-10% losses, VFD 98% at full load) are the only technology numbers. No measure costs, paybacks per measure, system efficiencies or lifetimes are printed. Fan-law savings rules and a belt example in _measures; market statistics in _other-values. Fan performance curves not read. The 75-122 billion kWh and Fig. 3-2 shares are reprinted from Xenergy 1998 (already extracted as xenergy_1998_001).
